returns.name: Pennsylvania Quarterly Withholding Return (W-3) and quarterly reconciliation
contents: Every entity required to withhold files a quarterly return and reconciliation for each quarter, plus W-2s for all employees and W-2 transmittals.
Returns are filed whether or not taxable transactions occur; myPATH, Telefile (1-800-748-8299) and paper for the income statements are the options.
myPATH filers may request an email reminder five business days before each due date.

deposits.interpretation: Pennsylvania sets the payment frequency from the withholding EXPECTED each quarter: under $300 QUARTERLY (by the last day of April, July, October and January); $300 to $999.99 MONTHLY (by the 15th of the succeeding month for January to November wages and by January 31 for December wages); $1,000 to $4,999.99 SEMI-MONTHLY (within three banking days after the close of each semi-monthly period; the periods end on the 15th and the last day of the month); $5,000 or more a quarter ($20,000 a year) SEMI-WEEKLY (the Wednesday after a Wednesday-Friday payday, the Friday after a Saturday-Tuesday payday). The employer decides from its expected quarterly withholding and may ask for a more frequent schedule 15 days before a quarter begins, so the frequency is an INPUT or is derived from a supplied expected quarterly liability. Separate account IDs exist for employer (W-2), other income (1099-MISC/NEC) and retirement (1099-R) withholding; this profile covers the employer account. Returns are filed whether or not taxable transactions occur. Local earned income tax is separate and not modelled.

channels.description: myPATH (mypath.pa.gov) online registration, filing and payment; Telefile 1-800-748-8299; paper accepted for PA W-2, 1099-MISC, 1099-NEC and 1099-R statements
enrollment: Obtain a federal EIN first, then register for withholding accounts through the Pennsylvania Online Business Tax Registration at mypath.pa.gov.
Register, file and pay each withholding type under a separate account ID: Employer Withholding (W-2), Other Income Withholding (1099-MISC/NEC), Retirement Withholding (1099-R).
